ablation.name: phase4g1b_lock_ll_zero_wll
ablation.notes: Phase 4G.1b: True LL lock in inference + w_ll=0 (no LL training). Combines 4A2's w_ll=0 with true inference lock. head_ll is untrained but no longer applied (so random v_ll is harmless). Tests if LL velocity is needed AT ALL. If PASS: LL can be entirely removed from architecture (saves params). If FAIL: LL velocity training (via w_ll>0) is still useful even when not applied (provides gradient signal to backbone).
